new.name: SELECTS_UNDERTESTED_PATH_FOR_VERIFICATION
new.definition: The reasoning proposes an additional check aimed at a behavior or path not yet exercised by prior verification, and justifies the choice by what that untested path would reveal about the implementation.

parameters.name: selection_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying an unexercised behavior and proposing a check for it.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific behavior or path that earlier verification did not exercise.
The reasoning states why exercising that path matters (for example, it would confirm replacement or update logic rather than first-time creation).
The proposed check is still open at the time of the reasoning, i.e., not yet performed.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning proposes repeating a check that was already performed and confirmed.
The reasoning lists planned steps without identifying any specific untested behavior.
The proposed work concerns cleanup or reporting rather than verification of behavior.

new.name: MEASURES_OPERATION_LATENCY
new.definition: The action instruments a specific operation with timing markers and derives the elapsed duration of that operation, producing a quantified latency figure that can be compared with a stated constraint.

parameters.name: timed_action
parameters.description: The action that brackets an operation with timing markers and computes elapsed time.

assertion_conditions: The action records a timestamp before and after a specific operation.
The action computes or reports the elapsed duration attributable to that operation.
exclusion_conditions: The action reports a timestamp or duration without bracketing any specific operation.
The timing markers span multiple unrelated operations so the resulting value cannot be attributed to one operation.

new.name: EVALUATES_RESULT_AGAINST_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERION
new.definition: The reasoning compares a concrete observed measurement or property against a stated requirement, threshold, or expected property and judges whether that requirement is satisfied.

parameters.name: evaluation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that states the requirement and renders a compliance judgment.

parameters.name: measured_observation
parameters.description: The observation supplying the concrete measurement or property being judged.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains an identifiable concrete value, measurement, or property.
The reasoning states a requirement, threshold, or expected property and explicitly relates the observed value to it.
The reasoning concludes that the requirement is met or not met.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning cites the observed result without comparing it to any requirement.
The comparison is asserted without any observed value to compare.
The observation lacks the quantity or property that the requirement concerns.

new.name: CONFIRMS_REQUIREMENTS_FROM_COLLECTIVE_EVIDENCE
new.definition: The reasoning concludes that a set of stated requirements are jointly satisfied, citing multiple distinct observations whose combined content separately covers the individual requirements.

parameters.name: confirmation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that asserts overall requirement satisfaction and ties each requirement to observed evidence.

parameters.name: supporting_observations
parameters.description: The observations whose combined content supplies evidence for the individual requirements; support is collective across the collection.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning asserts that several distinct requirements are satisfied.
Each cited requirement is matched to identifiable content from a different observation in the collection.
No requirement claimed as satisfied lacks corresponding observed evidence.
exclusion_conditions: The conclusion rests on a single observation covering only one requirement.
The reasoning enumerates requirements without linking them to observed evidence.
The observations address only part of the requirements while the reasoning claims all are satisfied.

new.name: PERFORMS_NONINVASIVE_READINESS_CHECK
new.definition: The action inspects externally observable service and artifact properties, such as listening ports, file presence and permissions, identity, or expected absence of served content, to establish that the environment is ready, without depending on a full end-to-end workflow to do so.

parameters.name: readiness_action
parameters.description: The action that inspects service and artifact state to establish readiness.

assertion_conditions: The action gathers observable state properties rather than executing the full end-to-end workflow.
The inspection covers at least one service listener and one deliverable artifact property.
The collected results can be interpreted as the environment being ready or not ready.
exclusion_conditions: The action performs the complete functional workflow to establish readiness.
The action modifies state rather than inspecting it.
The inspection covers a single superficial property and supports no readiness interpretation.

new.name: DECLARES_TASK_COMPLETION_WITH_REQUIREMENT_MAPPING
new.definition: The reasoning asserts that the task is complete and itemizes each stated requirement alongside the outcome or evidence that satisfied it, producing a final accountability record rather than an interim status update.

parameters.name: completion_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning containing the completion claim and the requirement-to-evidence mapping.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly claims that the overall task is complete.
The reasoning enumerates multiple requirements taken from the task statement.
Each enumerated requirement is associated with a satisfied outcome or identifiable evidence.
No requirement is presented as satisfied while also being described as unresolved.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning is an interim status report without a completion claim.
The reasoning asserts completion without mapping requirements to outcomes or evidence.
The reasoning lists some requirements as unresolved while still claiming full completion.

uncertain.name: RETRIES_WITH_TARGETED_CORRECTION
uncertain.definition: After a failed attempt, an action re-executes the same operation with a change directed at exactly the condition identified as the cause of failure, and the resulting observation reports the outcome of the corrected attempt.

parameters.name: retry_action
parameters.description: The action that re-executes the previously failed operation with the corrective change.

parameters.name: diagnosis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the condition responsible for the earlier failure.

parameters.name: retry_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the outcome of the corrected attempt.

assertion_conditions: A prior attempt of the same operation failed, as indicated by an error report or stated in the reasoning.
The reasoning identifies the condition that caused the failure.
The retry action differs from the failed attempt specifically in the condition implicated by the diagnosis.
The observation reports the result of the retried operation and is interpretable as success or continued failure.
exclusion_conditions: The retry repeats the same operation without changing the implicated condition.
The change made in the retry is unrelated to the diagnosed cause.
No preceding failure motivates the retry.
The observation cannot be attributed to the retried operation.

uncertain.name: IS_PRISTINE_STATE_RESTORATION_PLAN
uncertain.definition: The reasoning expresses an intent to remove artifacts produced during the session's verification work and return the deliverable environment to a neutral initial state expected by downstream consumers.

parameters.name: restoration_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the intent to reset the environment to its initial condition.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies state or artifacts created during the session that should not persist.
The reasoning states the target initial or pristine condition to be restored.
The reasoning enumerates removal or reset steps together with a planned readiness confirmation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning plans additional functionality or configuration rather than removal of session-produced state.
The reasoning only reports cleanup that has already been completed.
No target initial or pristine condition is referenced.

uncertain.name: RESTORES_PRISTINE_STATE
uncertain.definition: The action removes state created during testing and re-establishes empty target structures, leaving the deliverable in its initial condition while keeping it operational for subsequent use.

parameters.name: reset_action
parameters.description: The action that deletes session-produced state and recreates empty target structures.

assertion_conditions: The action deletes data, references, or files that were produced during verification.
The action recreates or re-establishes the empty target structures or ownership expected in the initial condition.
The action preserves or restores the operational readiness of the surrounding services.
exclusion_conditions: The action deletes only incidental temporary files without any defined initial state being restored.
The action leaves the tested state in place so the environment is not returned to its starting condition.
The action is destructive without re-establishing the structure the environment is expected to have.

uncertain.name: ASSESSES_POST_COMPLETION_CONSUMPTION_RISK
uncertain.definition: The reasoning models how the deliverable will be consumed or evaluated after the current session ends, identifies concrete residual risks to that continued use, and decides whether additional mitigation is warranted.

parameters.name: risk_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that anticipates post-session consumption and weighs residual risk.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning describes the expected post-session consumption or evaluation context.
The reasoning identifies a concrete residual risk to continued operation in that context.
The reasoning reaches a decision about whether to mitigate the risk or accept it.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning describes only work already completed.
The identified risk concerns the immediate next step rather than post-completion use.
No decision or assessment about mitigation is made.
